item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01605","case1_error":"Adds the 21, 4, and 18 books to the stated collection instead of subtracting them as donations.","case2_error":"Changes Edna’s self-referential distance statement to refer to Mary; also reports 4.5 for an expression equaling 4.","reason":"Case 2’s question contains a materially ambiguous self-reference, so its intended mathematical relation cannot be established reliably.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01606","case1_error":"Divides among four people, omitting Jose from the five recipients.","case2_error":"Answers Tully’s current age, 61, instead of his age a year ago, 60.","reason":"Case 1 uses an incorrect recipient count; case 2 correctly calculates an intermediate quantity but answers the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01607","case1_error":"Reports $15 for the correctly written expression (36 × $0.75) − $16, which equals $11.","case2_error":"Uses 1/10 as episodes watched daily instead of multiplying that fraction by 50 to obtain 5 episodes.","reason":"Case 1 gives an incorrect value for a correct expression; case 2 constructs an erroneous numerical relation from a fraction.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01608","case1_error":"Omits the 20% primer discount, charging $150 for primer instead of $120.","case2_error":"No mathematical error: 400 cents is the correct total, equivalent to $4.","reason":"Case 2 explicitly states cents and correctly answers the question; differing units from the reference do not establish an error.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01609","case1_error":"Performs four halving-and-donation rounds instead of the requested two.","case2_error":"Provides an unsupported final answer of 20 packs after correctly describing the formula, which yields 11.","reason":"Case 1 executes extra iterations; case 2 supplies an incorrect final number without showing a faulty calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
